title: Actionable Approaches to Promote Ethical AI in Libraries
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper does not conduct a benchmark measurement related to faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention religion or faith. Its focus is on proposing actionable approaches for promoting ethical AI in libraries by adapting existing, non-library specific guidelines and auditing frameworks.
